figures.finding: The only pay floor found for a performer employed on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius or Saba is the islands' own statutory minimum wage, set by the Dutch Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment: from 1 January 2026, USD 10.69 an hour on Bonaire, 10.61 on Sint Eustatius and 10.66 on Saba.

value.basis: statutory minimum wage of the Caribbean Netherlands, not a screen agreement

figures.applies: Caribbean Netherlands; all employees (the islands' own minimum wage, distinct from the European Netherlands).

sources.said: The Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment will adjust the amounts for minimum wage, child benefit, and social security benefits on Bonaire, St. Eustatius, and Saba as of 1 January 2026 … For Bonaire, it will increase by 3.3% to $10.69 per hour, for St. Eustatius by 1.9% to $10.61 … per hour, and for Saba by 3,5% to $10.66 per hour.

figures.finding: English, Dutch and Papiamentu are the official languages of Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba under the BES official-languages act as published in 2010; no source names the language of screen work.

value.basis: Tijdelijke wet officiële talen BES (Stb. 2010, 717), not a statement on film; the 2017 Invoeringswet chapter on language (not read) may since govern
